answer: The most convincing sybil-resistance mechanism is randomized grading-panel rotation each epoch. Panel members are drawn by verifiable randomness from the whole pool and revealed only after assignments lock. An attacker spawning thousands of fake falcon and juniper identities cannot predict which panels their shills land on, so rigging one grade requires buying a random majority of a random panel, costing order N times panel size per targeted epoch while payouts stay fixed, and reshuffling forces bribes to be repaid every epoch.
